🤖 Hi! I'm your Travel Planning Assistant.

I can help you with:
✈️ Creating detailed travel itineraries
🍽️ Finding great restaurants and dining options
🗺️ Discovering attractions and activities
📍 Getting travel information for any destination

Just send me a message like:
• "Plan a 5-day trip to Tokyo for $2000"
• "Find restaurants in Paris with good vegetarian options"
• "What are the best attractions in Barcelona?"

How can I help you plan your next adventure?

function escapeMarkdown(text) {
  if (!text) return text;
  return text
    .replace(/\\/g, '\\\\')   // escape backslash first
    .replace(/\*/g, '\\*')
    .replace(/_/g, '\\_')
    .replace(/\[/g, '\\[')
    .replace(/\]/g, '\\]')
    .replace(/\(/g, '\\(')
    .replace(/\)/g, '\\)')
    .replace(/~/g, '\\~')
    .replace(/`/g, '\\`')     // escape backticks
    .replace(/>/g, '\\>')
    .replace(/#/g, '\\#')
    .replace(/\+/g, '\\+')
    .replace(/=/g, '\\=')
    .replace(/\|/g, '\\|')
    .replace(/\{/g, '\\{')
    .replace(/\}/g, '\\}')
    .replace(/!/g, '\\!');
}

const userText = $json["message"]?.text || '';
const sanitizedText = escapeMarkdown(userText);

return [{ json: { sanitizedText } }];
